answer_1.quote: We evaluate our models on a diverse set of downstream tasks: (1) AlpacaEval (Li et al., 2023), which tests general instruction following capabilities; (2) GSM8k (Cobbe et al., 2021), which tests simple math word problems; (3) SQuAD (Rajpurkar et al., 2016) (with context), which tests general question-answering abilities; (4) TriviaQA (Joshi et al., 2017), a reading comprehension dataset; (5) IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023), which tests exact instruction-following; and (6) Big Bench Hard (BBH) (Suzgun et al., 2022), which tests general reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses for instruction following, question answering, mathematical reasoning, and general reasoning tasks

answer_2.quote: For adaptation evaluation, we evaluate our adaptation using perplexity, average distinct n-grams in the output samples (d-1/2/3/4), unigram (per-token) entropy, and Mauve score (Pillutla et al., 2021).
